name: Vivmark Residential
business_summary: Vivmark Residential focused on building, buying, and managing high-quality apartment communities across major U.S. metro areas. The company owns or held investments in more than 184,000 rental apartments across premier U.S. markets and over 11,100 apartments under construction.
quirks: DEAD TICKER: Equity Residential (CIK 0000906107) completed an all-stock merger of equals with AvalonBay Communities (AVB) effective 2026-08-17. Equity Residential was the surviving LEGAL entity (same CIK) and renamed itself Vivmark Residential effective with shareholder approval on 2026-08-12; AvalonBay was merged INTO Equity Residential, with each AVB share converting into 2.793 shares of the surviving company. The combined company began trading under a NEW ticker, NYSE: VMRK, at market open 2026-08-18. The EQR ticker itself was retired/delisted at that time -- it did not continue as an independent listing alongside VMRK.

A live-looking Yahoo Finance quote for EQR is STALE: its regularMarketTime is 2026-08-18 08:00:03 (the day after the merger closed), not a current session -- same pattern as stale-price-delisted-tickers. VMRK's quote is current.

No current market price exists for EQR. A DCF/dashboard valuation implying a live entry price was NOT built for this reason. Financial history (SEC XBRL, FY2006-FY2025+ annual/quarterly via scripts/extract.py) and qualitative analysis (EQR_Analysis.json) were completed and are usable for historical/backward-looking research.

Future research interest in this business should target VMRK (Vivmark Residential) as a new ticker, not EQR. Symmetric with AVB, which is also a dead ticker from the same merger -- see research/AVB/info.json.
